title.narrative: Iraq - Building Local Civil Society Capacities to Fight Corruption in Iraq

description.narrative: This project will use a multi-stakeholder approach while engaging local civil society groups from the anti-corruption field, state actors and policy makers, as well as with the Iraqi private sector. It will take a comprehensive approach to strengthen multiple layers of society including the judicial, economic, political, and civil society levels and aim to support Iraq as a whole. Three interconnected outcomes frame this project:• Strengthened capacities of local Iraqi civil society in topics related to corruption and good governance, including the identification and development of a Transparency International National Contact in Iraq•Increased capacities among relevant Iraqi state actors to implement and advance accountability reforms;• Improved internal business integrity measures among Iraqi private sector.Value of contract: EUR 1,106,050
